tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find Singapore registered entities by name or UEN. Matches an exact UEN, an exact name, or names that START WITH the query (case-insensitive). Live entities and shorter names rank first. Returns up to 10 compact results; call get_company with a UEN for the full record.
